Five vanilla chips (silencer, red dot sight, laser sight, 10mm magazine, Ironcraft 10 frame) consume metal ingots (some with printer filament) instead of scrap metal; recipes using ingots require the Metal Printing Module. Existing chips follow the setting. Before uninstalling this mod, turn this off and load and save once, or the chips in the save keep the ingot recipes.

Turns off new street clashes, gun reputation, upkeep, gun reoffers, new paint and sticker sources, collector orders and new Upper-Level Gunsmith bookings. Existing paint, stickers, gun history and upgrades are kept. Takes effect after restarting the game.
Street clashes between the Revolution and Security. Off: no new clash starts; one under way plays out. No effect with deep content off.

Delivering New or Excellent guns with stats no worse than a new gun of the model raises it; selling unrepaired war-damaged guns lowers it; every 3 days without such a sale it moves 1 back toward 0. It runs from −15 to +15 and changes the three gun buyers' visit chance (±15%) and order rewards (±7.5%); together with the showcase bonus, visits get at most +30%. Off: it neither changes nor counts. No effect with deep content off.

A famous gun that goes 7 days without gun oil loses its famous gun bonus (+15%) over the next 8 days. Off: famous guns keep it and gun oil has no use; turned back on, the 7 days start over. With deep content off nothing fades either.
Half the guns the mercenary gun seller brings have kills (1–24); 20 or more makes a famous gun. Off: no kills. No effect with deep content off.

30% of eligible high orders become collector orders: a big gun (size > 14) or a valuable one (value ≥ 300), in Epic or Legendary paint. The shop must have a qualifying finished gun, or a suitable gun and a usable Premium can. Of collector orders, 70% match current stock; 30% draw freely from both kinds and may need preparation. Off: no new orders. No effect with deep content off.

Gun parts from disassembly scale with condition: New 100%, Excellent 90%, Good 80%, Fair 65%, Poor 50% (rounded, at least 1); plastic and scrap stay. Off: vanilla amounts. No effect with deep content off.
The covert operation story. Off: it does not start; one already started plays out.
